definitions.equivalent: Same core stats and functional effect at equivalent tier; no identical trainer recipe verified in this dataset.
definitions.alternative: Meaningful shared purpose, with differences in buff stat, potency, level, reagents or acquisition.
definitions.distinct: No sufficiently close documented match; never claim exclusive availability.

recipes.comparison_scope: functionally similar consumables, not recipe duplication
recipes.effect_reported: Restores 145 mana over 18 sec; Well Fed +1 Spirit for 15 min; +5% experience from kills reported in Forever guides (not consistently present in every item tooltip)
recipes.summary: +1 Spirit Well Fed drink; close alternatives are other smoothies (different tiers) and Peace Tea (Healing Power instead of Spirit). No exact trainer-taught duplicate verified.

matches.name: Peace Tea
matches.similarity: Same Cooking-skill tier; restores mana and grants a 15-minute Well Fed bonus, but improves Healing Power instead of Spirit.
matches.difference: Smoothie grants +1 Spirit; the tea grants +2 Healing Power. This is not the same buff.
matches.source_note: Drop: Frostmane Seer (per Wowhead Cooking guide)
